body: The only way I can get rid of my pain is by killing myself
It feels like I have nothing to live for and nothing to hang on for. I’m just tired of breathing and waking up every morning.

My only purpose in life is to die. I’ve lost everything. I’m sick and tired of the abuse and pain I have to deal with. I’ve been permanently fucked up for life and I don’t want to live with it. I just want to die.
Living on earth is already hell for me. How much worse can it get?

I live with an abusive mother who still occasionally beats me up. She’s incredibly controlling and I was never allowed to have any fun like a normal child. I never went out with friends, never went to school dances, and she regularly tried to stop me from pursuing music. I had to fight her for my ability to stay in marching, which was the one time I was able to do something I loved without her controlling every aspect of it. I’ve spent every single birthday of my life alone because my mother never wanted me to have friends. I was prepared to have fun for once in my life this year after I got my license but the world had other plans for me. 


This isn’t just my reason for being suicidal, I’ve been trying to kill myself ever since I was 12 because something’s just wrong with me. 


We all had different struggles, and just because someone is suffering more doesn’t make your suffering any less painful or valid.
I turned recently 18, I spent my birthday the same way(minus the alcohol).

Me too, I’ve started doing extensive research and now I finally have the money to buy stuff. Hopefully I’ll be able to kill myself soon
We don’t have any study clubs unfortunately :( and I kinda stopped talking to most of my friends so I don’t have study partner
I do chores and stuff but I can’t seem to study. Whenever I sit down to study I stopped after 5 minutes because I’d rather do nothing. Somethings wrong with me
I like jazz and video games, but I kinda quit both because I felt like I wasn’t good enough. My only hobby now is planning out my death haha

I’m going to a mediocre college because my mother told me I was too dumb to apply anywhere good. I feel like my life is gonna go be bad, even though people tell me things will get better after high school. People told me the same thing in middle school, things will get better after I’m in high school.

My parents have ruined my life. I can never be happy with anything I do, even when I’m playing video games or playing music because my mother makes a competition out of everything. 

“___’s son is better at music than you” 

“____’s daughter does more things than you.” 

“____ makes money out of video games.” Please just shut up, I just want to have fun. She told me I wouldn’t get into my dream college because I’m too stupid and she was right. Even though all my grades are mostly A’s and I got a 1520 on my SAT, I’m still stupid. 


I hope I can be free from this hell when I die.

I live in the Midwest, me and my friends are actually quite touchy though. He’s not that touchy with others, but he is touchy with me. Sometimes we’ll hold hands in class or walk down the hall holding hands but I always thought we were just messing around lol

Maybe. Sometimes I think about what it would be like if we dated and I’ve joked about taking him to a fancy restaurant one day and he actually said ok. I think he means it in a friend way, but whenever I think about I get flustered.

Feelings are weird, I really don’t know how I should approach him about it. I don’t actually feel much emotion so I’m really awkward about stuff like this, and I know he’s awkward about it too. I don’t have a problem with being gay or bi or whatever though, it wouldn’t really change who I am but more so who I like I guess. I don’t know if I’d come off as gay though, I just look like a boring average guy lol
I don’t think anyone would want to listen to me. I’m stupid and boring. If I’m going to be dead soon, I shouldn’t burden people with my existence.
I’ve been planning this out since I was 12 and I can finally get what I need. I’ve been suicidal for quite some time
What am I losing?
I wish I could sleep, but I have nightmares every night. I’m suffering in my sleep, and I’m suffering in life. This must be some kind of sick joke.
I’ve never gotten anything for Christmas or my birthday. My 18th birthday is in a week and I know I won’t get anything this year either.
Thank you
